resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. cp2 (3683) and thal4 (3731) exactly affine; cp3xslope3 (245) near-inert (<=0.14 logit, AUC change 0.0003). Only the age hinge (1499) and BP/slope:1 hinge (3392) are material nonlinearity; replacing all gates with affine fits: train AUC 0.9407 -> 0.9384. Counterintuitive: fixed-defect thal:6 (-1.58 logit, n=15) and fbs:0 (+0.37).
tool_bugs: get_viz_summary activation_profile on identity nodes overrides them with relu (clips); computed locally. get_formula for the root drops composition children in both latex and latex_collapsed (root formula written by hand). Annotate validator rejects grandchild entry nodes. Output shown/extracted as relu(z); compute_performance applies sigmoid.
summary: Generalised additive logistic model: logit = -0.054 + linear backbone (11 features, logit SD 3.49) + four per-feature-group shape functions: inverted-U age effect peaking near 59; saturating resting-BP effect discounted by upsloping ST; per-category chest-pain lookup; additive thallium terms. Train AUC 0.9407; hidden-unit nonlinearity adds only ~0.002 AUC.
